title: 2012 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mini All4 Racing) and Cyril Despres (KTM)
summary: The 2012 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 13 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile, Peru. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mini All4 Racing); Bikes: Cyril Despres (KTM); Trucks: Gérard de Rooy (Iveco); Quads: Alejandro Patronelli (Yamaha).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
